title: SOTERIA: Language-Specific Functional Parameter Steering for Multilingual Safety Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment for LLMs, introducing the XThreatBench benchmark which evaluates models based on ethical and moral categories like hate speech, violence, and sexual exploitation derived from safety policy guidelines. It also provides examples and analysis regarding the preservation of religious and cultural contexts (e.g., Hanukkah, Christmas, Islamic schools) during the safety alignment process.
